column1: # products.tsv — used by tools/diff_expected.py to compare the outputs of a re-run with the data released in this repository.
# sha256: SHA-256 of the reference-run output (full, prefix, or 'prefix…suffix'); a re-run file with this SHA-256 is 'same'.
# expect_identical: whether a re-run is expected to give a byte-identical file ("yes" = confirmed by the full re-run of
# 2026-09-30; "no (...)" = always differs, reason given; a SHA-256 difference on a row that does not start with "no" is a failure
# unless the row is compared leaf by leaf). compare: sha (default); rows = compare the multiset of lines (SHA-256 of all lines
# sorted bytewise, each followed by a newline: rows_sha256; empty = file not released, so only a full-SHA match can pass);
# json = on a SHA-256 difference compare leaf by leaf with the released copy in data/products/ (numbers within 1e-12 + 1e-9*|old|,
# strings and keys through docs/translation-table.tsv), skipping the leaf paths in ignore (comma-separated fnmatch patterns on
# the pipeline's own key names; '[[]' and '[]]' match literal brackets). Ignored are run records (times, code hashes, input
# paths and input hashes, download counts) and text fields whose key or wording in the reference-run outputs differs from what
# the current scripts write (data/products/MANIFEST.tsv, treatment). Some ignore entries are key names that exist only in the
# reference-run outputs (historical keys of fields the current scripts no longer write); they are kept only so that those outputs
# can still be compared. No numeric field is ignored; any other leaf difference is a failure. Rows of stages that are not part of
# run.py --all (dw33-bench) are reported as not-run when the stage directory is absent.
